Article 3 (Retention Period of Materials)
(1) The retention period of materials transferred pursuant to Article 13 (5) of the North Korean Human Rights Act and Article 14 (3) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act shall be permanent: Provided, That the head of the North Korean Human Rights Archives may designate a retention period of ten years for materials deemed not to require permanent preservation. <Amended on June 21, 2019.>
(2) The head of the North Korean Human Rights Archives may extend the retention period for materials falling under the proviso to paragraph (1) where an extension is deemed necessary. <Amended on June 21, 2019.>
